author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407
#smallpoems
There is No B Writer or A Writer
You must simply Be A Writer
anyone can grow you know
but we interrupted your flow
conflating growth and grades
watching as motivation fades
real quick one gets
rubric sick
a scale
of measure
ripping away pleasure
leaving learning untouched
